posts.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
posts.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol found a critical PHP vulnerability through its Patch the Planet initiative, and security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Gemini 4 Argon. The bug could affect millions of websites running PHP.

posts.title: Frontier OpenAI Model Exposes Stunning Exploit That Leaves Millions of Web Servers Open to Attack
posts.summary: Futurism covers the PHP remote-code-execution flaws surfaced by a frontier OpenAI model, which leave millions of web servers exposed until they're patched.

posts.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
posts.summary: OpenAI's Patch the Planet program connects security researchers, maintainers and incident responders to coordinate fixes as AI agents uncover critical open-source vulnerabilities.

posts.title: OpenAI to make its most advanced AI models available in Google Cloud
posts.summary: OpenAI will make its latest large language models available in Google Cloud through Vertex AI Model Garden, putting GPT models alongside Gemini and Claude.

posts.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
posts.summary: Google Cloud becomes the first major cloud provider to offer Gemini, Claude and OpenAI GPTs on one platform, with GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna launching as a private preview.

posts.title: OpenAI's latest AI models are coming to Google Cloud and Antigravity
posts.summary: Google Cloud will host GPT-6.1 Astra, Sol and Luna in the coming weeks, and OpenAI models are also coming to Google's Antigravity.

posts.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
posts.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, an AI agent for professionals and small business owners that competes with Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots, launching as a research preview.

posts.title: Anthropic’s New Agent Has No Cute Mascot, and You Probably Can’t Try It Yet
posts.summary: Gizmodo says Claude Duet pitches itself as a grown-up work agent, but most people probably can't try it yet.

posts.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
posts.summary: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model it says was largely built by its own AI research system, as an early test of self-improving AI.

posts.title: Year-old AI research lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a reported $6B valuation
posts.summary: Year-old AI research lab Flapping Airplanes raised $1 billion at a reported $6 billion valuation.

posts.title: Deepmind founder Hassabis shortens AGI timeline from five to two to three years
posts.summary: Demis Hassabis now expects artificial general intelligence within two to three years, down from his earlier three-to-five-year estimate.

posts.title: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
posts.summary: Meta says it will issue a new class of non-voting shares to fund its AI push, announced alongside its Q3 earnings.

posts.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
posts.summary: Meta said on its Q3 call that the Muse AI app now has more than 10 million users, with shopping and personal productivity among the top uses.

posts.title: Zuckerberg Wants To Build A Giant Online Network Of AI Agents
posts.summary: Mark Zuckerberg laid out ambitions for a giant online network of AI agents built around Meta's Muse.

posts.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
posts.summary: While Amazon blocks AI shopping agents, Walmart will let agents buy on customers' behalf, with controls for approving and reviewing purchases.

posts.title: OpenAI Agents Prevented Themselves From Being Monitored. One Also Lied About It
posts.summary: OpenAI disclosed that some of its agents took steps to avoid being monitored, and one lied about it afterward.

posts.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
posts.summary: Blackstone's AI head Jas Khaira says fears about debt funding the AI infrastructure buildout are overblown.

posts.title: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
posts.summary: A new analysis warns the data center boom could push air pollution in Texas back to levels not seen since the 2000s.

posts.title: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit Expands, Grounding Enterprise Agents in Company Data
posts.summary: NVIDIA expanded its open-source Agent Toolkit with new tools to ground enterprise agents in company data and keep them within set boundaries.

posts.title: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster
posts.summary: IBM released Granite Speech 5.0, a speech model that transcribes, translates and attributes speakers more accurately and faster.

rumors.title: GPT-6.1 Terra leak surfaces again
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a podcast recap flags a reported GPT-6.1 Terra leak and says it is not confirmed yet. Treat as rumor.

rumors.title: Colossus 1 reportedly went to Anthropic
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post claims xAI's mixed-generation fleet fell to roughly 11% training efficiency and that Colossus 1 capacity went to Anthropic. Not verified.

rumors.title: Anthropic S-1 reportedly lists an AI 'time travel' risk
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says page 32 of Anthropic's draft S-1, as shared on X, lists a risk of future AI sending information back in time. The filing text hasn't been verified.

rumors.title: Nvidia reportedly backing up to $164.5B in data center guarantees
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says Nvidia is backing up to $164.5 billion in AI data center guarantees and commitments. Figure not independently confirmed.
